newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly firmer Tuesday as the market recovered following a modest rise in LME stocks.
COMEX copper ended more than four cents weaker on Monday.
Copper inventory at the London exchange rose 1,000 tonnes Tuesday to 93,475 tonnes, a smaller than expected rise.
COMEX March copper was called to open 0.40 to 0.60 cent per pound firmer, after trading in a 101.40-99.35 cents range in overnight ACCESS trade.
The cash to three months backwardation on LME continued to soften overnight, and had shrunk to $155 to $165 just before the COMEX opening, down some $25 since Monday evening.
Lead indicators for October were due at 0830 EST, with October's U.S. new home sales, forecast at 772,000 units, scheduled for 1000.
